name: one-off-stays-one-off
note: The opposite failure: guidance about clocks must not make the model schedule things nobody asked to repeat. A one-time request gets a workflow at most — no schedule. An ask-first run (the guide's step 1) ends at the question and is compliant as long as nothing was scheduled.
prompt: Make a workflow that reads notes.md and writes a one-paragraph summary to summary.md. I'll run it myself when I need it.
